## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint:ci`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Security Checklist

- [ ] I did not commit real secrets, tokens, or private keys.
- [ ] I did not commit tracked dotenv files (except `.env.example`).
- [ ] I reviewed auth, billing, and data-access changes for tenant isolation and least privilege.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for critical logic changes.

## Risk

What can break in production? What is the rollback plan?
